acceptance: evolve comments strip keeps every line of a multi-line acs-predicate marker group (red first, on a fixture copied from go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_wave_boundaryrefresh_wiring_test.go lines 3-5)
comments verify accepts a file whose marker group is unchanged and whose other comments were removed
fix: Treat the comment lines that continue an acs-predicate marker, up to the first blank or code line, as part of the kept marker in strip, the same way the convention keeps multi-line markers whole. Then strip the rest of cmd_loop_wave_boundaryrefresh_wiring_test.go, which comment-zero lane M3 left untouched for this reason.
summary: In go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_wave_boundaryrefresh_wiring_test.go the acs-predicate marker spans lines 3-5. evolve comments strip kept only line 3, which then ended mid-sentence at 'inherent source-'. Completing the line by hand made comments verify report 'directive changed'. Lane M3 restored the file from HEAD and left its comments in place.
title: comments strip keeps only the first line of a multi-line acs-predicate marker
